provisions.summary: Taxes net long-term capital gains of individuals, estates and trusts as ordinary income, except gains from the sale of a principal home eligible for a county homeowner's exemption, which are taxed at 7.25%.
provisions.approximation: The spec can only set one capital gains rate for all net long-term gains, so it taxes gains on a principal home as ordinary income although the bill keeps a flat 7.25% rate on them, so the revenue estimate is too high.
provisions.quote: be at a rate of 7.25 per cent

provisions.summary: Repeals the alternative capital gains tax for corporations, regulated investment companies and real estate investment trusts (section 235-71.5), which taxed corporate net capital gain at 4%.
provisions.quote: Section 235-71.5, Hawaii Revised Statutes, is repealed.

notes: Section 1 only removes a cross-reference to section 235-71.5 from the electronic filing statute, so it is a conforming amendment, not a provision. Section 3's corporate repeal is not modeled because the model covers individual income tax. The effective date of July 1, 3000 looks like a placeholder; the bill says it applies to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2026, so first_year is 2027. The capital_gains_rate key covers the individual alternative tax in section 235-51(f); Section 2's text keeps 7.25% only for principal-home gains eligible for a county homeowner's exemption, which the spec cannot separate from other gains.
